answer: The vault schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the horizon checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. An attacker wanting 46 effective identities must lock that capital for 84 epochs and keep it locked through every dune audit. Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 84 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. That is 14 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
